doc.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Meta Report: October 30, 2026
doc.summary: The Yu-Gi-Oh! meta report for October 30, 2026: Power Patron / Light and Darkness Ritual rose fastest in TCG, and Invoked rose fastest in Genesys. What moved on the YGO Omega ranked ladders this week.

facts.label: TCG riser
facts.value: Power Patron / Light and Darkness Ritual

blocks.md: This Yu-Gi-Oh! meta report covers what moved on the YGO Omega ranked ladders, using data through October 29, 2026. Power Patron / Light and Darkness Ritual rose fastest in TCG, and Invoked rose fastest in Genesys.
For where every deck stands, see the [TCG tier list](/wiki/yu-gi-oh-tcg-tier-list) and the [Genesys tier list](/wiki/yu-gi-oh-genesys-tier-list). This report only covers the changes.

blocks.text: Yu-Gi-Oh! meta report: which decks moved?

blocks.md: Change compares meta share over the latest days with the same span before them, in percentage points. Season share, tier and win rate cover the whole season, so a deck can rise fast from a small base.

A shift is listed when a deck's meta share moves at least 2 points, or its win rate at least 5, between two blocks of days with 200 or more games each and the two intervals don't overlap.

| Ladder | Deck | Shift | From | To | Games |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| TCG | **Gem-** | **[Win rate down]{#ff8594}** | 51.7% | 43.0% | 546 |
| TCG | **Thunder Dragon** | **[Win rate down]{#ff8594}** | 58.6% | 50.9% | 825 |
| TCG | **Artmage** | **[Win rate up]{#4fdc8c}** | 36.1% | 52.0% | 200 |
| Genesys | **Dragonmaid / Dracotail** | **[Win rate down]{#ff8594}** | 59.0% | 45.9% | 303 |
| Genesys | **Witchcrafter / Fairy Tail** | **[Win rate down]{#ff8594}** | 67.8% | 56.3% | 634 |
| Genesys | **Darklord** | **[Win rate down]{#ff8594}** | 57.9% | 51.0% | 751 |

blocks.text: TCG: Power Patron / Light and Darkness Ritual

blocks.md:
Power Patron / Light and Darkness Ritual gained 1.2 points of meta share over the last 5 days, the most on the ladder, for 1.2% of the season so far. It wins 53.0% ±1.2 overall: 58.6% going first and 47.3% going second.
- **Most used generic cards:** [Mulcharmy Fuwalos](/wiki/card/42141493), [Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring](/wiki/card/14558127) and [Droll & Lock Bird](/wiki/card/94145021)

blocks.md:
Invoked gained 1.1 points of meta share over the last 7 days, the most on the ladder, for 1.9% of the season so far. It wins 55.1% ±1.6 overall: 62.3% going first and 47.9% going second.
- **Most used generic cards:** [Skull Meister](/wiki/card/67750322), [Ghost Ogre & Snow Rabbit](/wiki/card/59438930) and [Mulcharmy Fuwalos](/wiki/card/42141493)

blocks.title: Where these numbers come from
blocks.md: Ranked matches on YGO Omega, not tournament results. Seasons run per ladder, so TCG and Genesys cover different dates. [How the tiers work](/wiki/yu-gi-oh-tcg-tier-list#methodology).

items.q: What changed in the Yu-Gi-Oh! meta this week?
items.md: Power Patron / Light and Darkness Ritual rose fastest in TCG, and Invoked rose fastest in Genesys. The tables above list every top mover.

items.q: What is the difference between this report and the tier lists?
items.md: The [TCG tier list](/wiki/yu-gi-oh-tcg-tier-list) and the [Genesys tier list](/wiki/yu-gi-oh-genesys-tier-list) rank every deck and are updated in place. This report is a dated record of what moved that week.

items.q: How often is the meta report published?
items.md: Every week, with data from the ranked ladders up to the day before.
